note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The warehouse, its tables and the platform totals are invented; no query ran on a real project.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "marketing-data-warehouse" skill. Our ad data lands in BigQuery and the dashboard never matches Google Ads or Meta. Check the loaded tables against each platform for the last 30 days, tell me what's broken and give me the SQL to fix it. Then tell me our cost per new paid subscription by platform.

settings.source: the user's answers; the lookback is read from the saved scheduled query
